sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在清晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空的七个十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的外面是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我在测试七张床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60个超级圣代冰淇淋。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最好的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天使用不同的起始单词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢一个平底锅就能做好的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，持续陪伴您理解世界，过好每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，享受nytimes.com/subscribe上的特惠。

sentences.en: Hey, it's Michael.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是迈克尔。

sentences.en: All this week, The Daily is revisiting some of our favorite episodes of the year, listening back and hearing what's happened in the time since they first ran.
sentences.zh: 整个这周，《每日新闻》都在重温我们今年最喜欢的一些单集，回顾过去并了解它们首次播出以来发生的事情。

sentences.en: Today, we return to the subject of President Trump's broad and historic crackdown on immigration
sentences.zh: 今天，我们回到特朗普总统对移民进行广泛且历史性打击的主题上来。

sentences.en: To reach his promised deportation numbers, Trump increasingly sought to deport those without a criminal record.
sentences.zh: 为了达到他承诺的驱逐人数，特朗普越来越频繁地寻求驱逐那些没有犯罪记录的人。

sentences.en: Those who came to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那些来到美国的人

sentences.en: decades ago and who have established lives, careers, and family in this country.
sentences.zh: 几十年前就在这个国家建立生活、事业和家庭的人。

sentences.en: Daily producer Jessica Chung told the story of one such man who was detained this year through the eyes of his daughter.
sentences.zh: 《每日新闻》制作人杰西卡·钟通过他女儿的视角，讲述了今年被拘留的这样一位男士的故事。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, December 30th.
sentences.zh: 今天是12月30日，星期二。

sentences.en: So I was in class.
sentences.zh: 当时我正在上课。

sentences.en: I was about to turn in all my work to the teacher.
sentences.zh: 我正准备把所有的作业交给老师。

sentences.en: So I was already starting to pack up my things slowly.
sentences.zh: 所以我已经开始慢慢收拾我的东西了。

sentences.en: And I got a call from my mom.
sentences.zh: 然后我接到了我妈妈的电话。

sentences.en: She seemed very down.
sentences.zh: 她显得非常沮丧。

sentences.en: And she was like, it's like when you hear somebody, they're trying not to cry, but like they're really like holding it in.
sentences.zh: 她就像那种当你听到某人说话时，他们极力忍住不哭，但其实硬撑着的感觉。

sentences.en: And I could hear in her voice.
sentences.zh: 我能从她的声音里听出来。

sentences.en: And that's when I started to get a little bit worried.
sentences.zh: 就在那时我开始有点担心了。

sentences.en: She told me that like, your father got detained.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，你父亲被拘留了。

sentences.en: And it's just like, you just start envisioning the worSt.
sentences.zh: 这就好比，你开始想象最糟糕的情况。

sentences.en: Like, he's in this terrible place.
sentences.zh: 比如，他在那种可怕的地方。

sentences.en: This is a hardworking man.
sentences.zh: 这是一个努力工作的男人。

sentences.en: No criminal record.
sentences.zh: 没有犯罪记录。

sentences.en: Like, you guys just took him.
sentences.zh: 就像，你们就这样把他带走了。

sentences.en: I first spoke to Isla back in February.
sentences.zh: 我最早在2月份和艾拉谈过。

sentences.en: This was a month into the Trump administration, which had promised quick and mass deportations.
sentences.zh: 当时正是特朗普政府上台一个月，该政府曾承诺进行迅速且大规模的驱逐。

sentences.en: I was calling immigration lawyers around the country, trying to get a sense of who exactly was getting targeted for deportation and how ICE was finding them.
sentences.zh: 我当时在给全国各地的移民律师打电话，试图弄清楚究竟谁是驱逐的目标，以及移民及海关执法局（ICE）是如何找到他们的。

sentences.en: And that's when a lawyer called me back, saying you got to talk to Isla.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，一位律师给我回了电话，说你得跟艾拉谈谈。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: So this is Jessica.
sentences.zh: 这是杰西卡。

sentences.en: This is Ayla.
sentences.zh: 这是艾拉。

sentences.en: She's Fabrizio's 20-year-old daughter.
sentences.zh: 她是法布里齐奥20岁的女儿。

sentences.en: Okay, great.
sentences.zh: 好的，太好了。

sentences.en: Nice to meet you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴认识你。

sentences.en: Nice to meet you, too.
sentences.zh: 我也很高兴认识你。

sentences.en: My name is Isla Gomez.
sentences.zh: 我叫艾拉·戈麦斯。

sentences.en: Right now, Isla's a sophomore at Wentworth Institute of Technology in Massachusetts, where she's studying architecture and interior design.
sentences.zh: 目前，艾拉是马萨诸塞州温特沃斯理工学院的二年级学生，在那里她学习建筑和室内设计。

sentences.en: She was raised in a town called Saugus, just outside Boston, where days before we had talked, her dad was detained by ICE officers.
sentences.zh: 她在波士顿郊外一个叫绍格斯的镇上长大，就在我们交谈几天前，她的父亲被移民及海关执法局（ICE）的官员拘留了。

sentences.en: Tell me a little bit about your dad.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲你爸爸吧。

sentences.en: What is his name?
sentences.zh: 他叫什么名字？

sentences.en: How old is he?
sentences.zh: 他多大了？

sentences.en: And what does he do?
sentences.zh: 他是做什么的？

sentences.en: My dad, he's Fabrizio Gomez.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸，他是法布里齐奥·戈麦斯。

sentences.en: He is 47 years old, and he works at a construction company of his own.
sentences.zh: 他47岁，经营着他自己的建筑公司。

sentences.en: Isla told me in 2001, her dad had settled here in Massachusetts as an undocumented immigrant.
sentences.zh: 艾拉告诉我，2001年，她爸爸作为无证移民在马萨诸塞州安顿下来。

sentences.en: He'd come here from Brazil.
sentences.zh: 他是从巴西来到这里的。

sentences.en: This was three years before Isla was born.
sentences.zh: 这在艾拉出生前三年。

sentences.en: Tell me about why he left Brazil.
sentences.zh: 跟我讲讲他为什么离开巴西。

sentences.en: Sorry, I'm just asking, like, these questions for my mom.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，我只是在问我妈妈这些问题。

sentences.en: So my mom said it was due to the violence down there, and, like, he couldn't make a living for himself, let alone have a family down there.
sentences.zh: 所以我妈妈说是因为那里的暴力活动，而且，他自己在那里都难以谋生，更不用说在那里养家糊口了。

sentences.en: When he first got here, he lived with his aunt, who was already here.
sentences.zh: 他刚到这里时，和已经在这里的姑姑住在一起。

sentences.en: But eventually, he met Isla's mom, who's also from Brazil.
sentences.zh: 但最终，他遇到了艾拉的妈妈，她也是巴西人。

sentences.en: They actually walked into each other, and they were like, oh my God, like, I remember you, blah, blah, blah.
sentences.zh: 他们其实是偶遇的，然后他们就觉得，天哪，我记得你，巴拉巴拉。

sentences.en: And they moved out on their own, with money Fabrizio made by working in construction.
sentences.zh: 他们靠法布里齐奥做建筑赚来的钱，搬出去单过。

sentences.en: So he had been working, like, small jobs, almost like a handyman.
sentences.zh: 所以他一直做些零工，差不多就像个杂务工。

sentences.en: And then he met somebody, which is my dad's old boss that still remains in our life, Ken.
sentences.zh: 然后他遇到了一个人，也就是我爸爸的老板、至今仍在我们生活中出现的肯。

sentences.en: And he slowly taught my dad how to work.
sentences.zh: 他慢慢教我爸爸怎么干活。

sentences.en: It went from, like, changing door panels, windows, to fixing inside the house.
sentences.zh: 从更换门板、窗户，到修理房屋内部。

sentences.en: And then it went to roofing, until he gathered up all his knowledge that he had.
sentences.zh: 然后到做屋顶，直到他积攒了所有的知识。

sentences.en: And then that's when he decided that he was ready to open his company and start creating a life for himself and our family.
sentences.zh: 然后他决定自己准备好开公司了，并开始为自己和我们的家庭创造生活。

sentences.en: And is your sense that he loves his job?
sentences.zh: 你觉得他热爱他的工作吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: My dad is actually very passionate for his job.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸对他的工作其实非常有热情。

sentences.en: You would think he wouldn't be, because you're constantly going up a ladder.
sentences.zh: 你会觉得他不会喜欢，因为你得经常爬梯子。

sentences.en: It's so cold, since we live in Massachusetts.
sentences.zh: 而且因为我们住在马萨诸塞州，天气非常冷。

sentences.en: And it's really a hard job.
sentences.zh: 这真的是一份辛苦的工作。

sentences.en: Even though he wasn't fluent in English, he had this way of connecting with people.
sentences.zh: 尽管他的英语不够流利，但他有一种与人沟通的方式。

sentences.en: My dad, he's always talked to his clients, like, he knew them for so long.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸总是跟他的客户聊天，就像他们认识了很久一样。

sentences.en: I don't know how he talks to them, like, everybody understands him.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他是怎么跟他们聊的，反正每个人都能听懂他。

sentences.en: For as long as she can remember, Islas wanted to be just like him.
sentences.zh: 在艾拉记事起，她就想成为像他一样的人。

sentences.en: As a little kid, I was, like, my dad's kind of tomboy.
sentences.zh: 小时候，我有点像我爸爸那样的假小子。

sentences.en: I'd always buy construction little kid's kit.
sentences.zh: 我总是买儿童建筑玩具套装。

sentences.en: And I would always go around the house with, like, plastic toys.
sentences.zh: 我总是拿着塑料玩具在家里转悠。

sentences.en: Me and my dad are the type of person where we take something that is not good and we reform it.
sentences.zh: 我和我爸爸是那种会把不好的东西拿来重新改造的人。

sentences.en: When something's not designed properly, it just feels down.
sentences.zh: 当某样东西设计得不合理时，就会让人感到沮丧。

sentences.en: And when you reform it, it brings another life.
sentences.zh: 而当你改造它时，它就带来了另一种生命力。

sentences.en: It sounds like you and your dad shared a special bond over your love of building things.
sentences.zh: 听起来你和你爸爸因为对建造东西的热爱而有着特殊的纽带。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I always wanted to work with my dad, which is why I went to college for architecture and interior design.
sentences.zh: 我一直想和我爸爸一起工作，这就是为什么我上大学学建筑和室内设计的原因。

sentences.en: So eventually, in the future, I could work with my dad's company.
sentences.zh: 这样以后在未来，我就可以和我爸爸的公司一起工作了。

sentences.en: Islas says her dream is that her dad's company becomes a family company with her.
sentences.zh: 艾拉说她的梦想是让她爸爸的公司和她一起变成一个家族企业。

sentences.en: His dream was always for us to go to college and pursue something that we have passion for because they weren't able to choose their own path.
sentences.zh: 他的梦想一直是让我们上大学，追求我们真正热爱的事物，因为他们当年无法选择自己的道路。

sentences.en: You're not born saying, I'm going to clean toilets.
sentences.zh: 你生下来不是为了说，我要去擦马桶。

sentences.en: I'm going to be a contractor.
sentences.zh: 我要当个承包商。

sentences.en: You're born thinking, like, I want to be a businesswoman.
sentences.zh: 你生下来时的想法是，我想成为一个女商人。

sentences.en: I want to have my own company.
sentences.zh: 我想拥有自己的公司。

sentences.en: I want to have my own home.
sentences.zh: 我想拥有自己的家。

sentences.en: And it's just like, that's what their main goal for us was, that we're able to choose our own path.
sentences.zh: 这就好像，他们对我们的主要目标就是让我们能够选择自己的道路。

sentences.en: My dad, he's always been the person to tell us, work hard.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸一直是个告诉我们要努力工作的人。

sentences.en: Nothing's gifted.
sentences.zh: 没有什么东西是天赐的。

sentences.en: Nothing's handed.
sentences.zh: 没有什么东西是凭空送给你的。

sentences.en: Go after it.
sentences.zh: 去追求它。

sentences.en: So fast forward to today, the dream that you described your dad having for you guys was in progress.
sentences.zh: 快进到今天，你所描述的你爸爸对你们的梦想正在进行中。

sentences.en: Like, you're in college.
sentences.zh: 比如，你在上大学。

sentences.en: Your dad is working hard at a business that he owns.
sentences.zh: 你爸爸在他拥有的企业里努力工作。

sentences.en: And when Trump was inaugurated on January 20th, did your family have conversations about what precautions you guys would take,
sentences.zh: 当特朗普在1月20日就职时，你们家有没有讨论过要采取什么防范措施，

sentences.en: given that he was aggressively pursuing people without documentation?
sentences.zh: 鉴于他正在大举针对无证人员？

sentences.en: I would always ask my dad, like, should we worry?
sentences.zh: 我总是问我爸爸，我们该担心吗？

sentences.en: And he'd always tell us, like, no.
sentences.zh: 他总是告诉我们，不用。

sentences.en: Like, there's, don't worry.
sentences.zh: 比如，别担心。

sentences.en: As much as, obviously, when I'm alone, you always have that thought in the back of your mind, like, what am I going to do?
sentences.zh: 尽管很显然，当我一个人的时候，你的脑海深处总会有那个想法：我该怎么办？

sentences.en: What if things go down?
sentences.zh: 如果事情搞砸了怎么办？

sentences.en: Fabrizio had no criminal record.
sentences.zh: 法布里齐奥没有犯罪记录。

sentences.en: And he didn't want to hide from law enforcement.
sentences.zh: 他也不想躲避执法人员。

sentences.en: He wanted to do things the right way.
sentences.zh: 他想用正确的方式做事。

sentences.en: He's had a pending application for a visa.
sentences.zh: 他有一个待审批的签证申请。

sentences.en: In the meantime, he's been checking in with ICE.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，他一直在向移民局报到。

sentences.en: He's been doing that for 12 years.
sentences.zh: 他已经这样做了12年。

sentences.en: In February, just one month after Trump's inauguration, he was due for another check-in.
sentences.zh: 在2月份，就在特朗普就职一个月后，他又到了定期报到的时间。

sentences.en: So he just shows up for his yearly check-in.
sentences.zh: 所以他只是按时去进行年度报到。

sentences.en: And you go there, you represent yourself, talk about whatever is being asked.
sentences.zh: 你去了那里，代表你自己，谈论任何被询问的事情。

sentences.en: And that was about it.
sentences.zh: 差不多就是这样。

sentences.en: And so her dad shows up to his check-in like he always does.
sentences.zh: 然后她爸爸像往常一样去报到。

sentences.en: And it was soon after that, that her mom called her in class, notifying Isla that her dad had been detained.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，她妈妈在课堂上给她打电话，通知艾拉她爸爸被拘留了。

sentences.en: After I was hyperventilating, I felt like my heart just left my cheSt.
sentences.zh: 在我过度换气之后，我感觉我的心好像直接从胸口跳出来了。

sentences.en: I think about him being there.
sentences.zh: 我一想到他在那里。

sentences.en: I think about him being in this close-up space.
sentences.zh: 我一想到他在那个狭小的空间里。

sentences.en: So I worry a lot at night.
sentences.zh: 所以我晚上经常担心。

sentences.en: Like, what if he's panicking and we don't know?
sentences.zh: 比如，如果他恐慌而我们却不知道怎么办？

sentences.en: What if he's old and strong, but he's actually having the hardest time in his life?
sentences.zh: 如果他虽然年岁渐长且很坚强，但其实正在经历他一生中最艰难的时刻呢？

sentences.en: Like, that's what constantly replays in my head.
sentences.zh: 这正是我脑海里不断重演的画面。

sentences.en: So it just felt like my whole heart got ripped out of my chest because I never got to really say a proper goodbye.
sentences.zh: 所以感觉就像我的整个心被从胸口硬生生撕裂了一样，因为我从来没有真正好好道个别。

sentences.en: Like, I'll see you later.
sentences.zh: 比如，回头见。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·朗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，一个专注于设计之美及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you.
sentences.zh: 甚至在黑胶唱片时代我在夜总会当DJ的时候，你每天晚上都要带300件你最珍贵的传家宝去工作。

sentences.en: And you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把一个DJ台变成了这样一个充满活力的快闪博物馆，里面摆满了精美的50年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 立即在您最喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是刘温娜。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写《纽约时报》游戏中的游戏《Connections》（词语连线）。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky.
sentences.zh: 我是山姆·阿泽斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天都会创作“拼字蜜蜂”和“信箱”这两款游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚刚听到那些人的那样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com 斜杠 games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: Isla's dad was detained on February 26.
sentences.zh: 艾丝拉的父亲于 2月 26 日被扣留。

sentences.en: He was taken to the Plymouth County Correctional Facility, about an hour's drive away from their home.
sentences.zh: 他被带到了普利茅斯县惩教所，距离他们的家大约有一小时的车程。

sentences.en: Eventually, Isla was able to reach him on the phone.
sentences.zh: 最终，艾丝拉通过电话联系上了他。

sentences.en: I'll give it to my dad.
sentences.zh: 我会把它交给我爸爸。

sentences.en: From the first day that he called us to speak to us, that man has holding strong.
sentences.zh: 从他给我们打电话与我们交谈的第一天起，那个男人就一直坚强地挺着。

sentences.en: He has the most positive energy and so positive that he will see us and things will go back to not normal,
sentences.zh: 他有着最积极的能量，而且非常乐观，他会看着我们，事情会回到非正常状态，

sentences.en: because I don't feel like anybody could really treat life as normal after the situation, but definitely better.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得在经历了这种情况之后，没有人能真正把生活当作正常，但绝对会更好。

sentences.en: Isla's dad told her to hold strong, too.
sentences.zh: 艾丝拉的父亲也告诉她要坚强。

sentences.en: He said the detention center wasn't so bad.
sentences.zh: 他说拘留中心没有那么糟糕。

sentences.en: He told her he'd gotten a job cleaning, which allowed more time outside of his cell.
sentences.zh: 他告诉她，他找到了一份做清洁的工作，这让他有更多时间待在牢房外面。

sentences.en: He started a Bible study with a group of other detainees.
sentences.zh: 他和一群其他被扣留者一起发起了一项圣经学习小组。

sentences.en: And he was allowed visitors.
sentences.zh: 而且他是允许探视的。

sentences.en: I'm the only one eligible to visit because I'm over 18.
sentences.zh: 我是唯一有资格去探视的人，因为我已经满了 18 岁。

sentences.en: But he told me, like, as much as I would love to see you guys so much, just don't come here because this is not the person that I am.
sentences.zh: 但他对我说，虽然我很想念你们大家，但千万别来这里，因为这不是真正的我。

sentences.en: And it would hurt to see you get up from that chair and turn your back and have to leave.
sentences.zh: 而且看着你从那张椅子上站起来、转过身去不得不离开，会让人很心痛。

sentences.en: But as the days in custody turn into weeks, the two of them adapted to a new version of their relationship.
sentences.zh: 但随着羁押的日子变成几周，他们两人适应了他们关系的新版本。

sentences.en: No visits.
sentences.zh: 没有探视。

sentences.en: They talk on the phone.
sentences.zh: 他们在电话里交谈。

sentences.en: A lot.
sentences.zh: 非常频繁。

sentences.en: As often as five times a day.
sentences.zh: 多达一天五次。

sentences.en: We open every conversation like he was here with us.
sentences.zh: 我们每次通话的开场白都好像他就在我们身边一样。

sentences.en: Like I'm walking into the house saying hi to him.
sentences.zh: 就像我走进屋子向他打招呼一样。

sentences.en: Ben said, hi, dad.
sentences.zh: 本说，嗨，爸爸。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: I missed you.
sentences.zh: 我很想你。

sentences.en: We continue lives how it is on the phone.
sentences.zh: 我们继续着电话里的生活方式。

sentences.en: I gave him updates on my grades.
sentences.zh: 我向他汇报了我的成绩。

sentences.en: I gave him updates on my finals.
sentences.zh: 我向他汇报了我的期末考试情况。

sentences.en: Well, I can't show to him my projects since they're all, like, online-based because they're all, like, floor plans, stuff like that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不能把我的项目展示给他看，因为它们基本上都是基于网络的，因为它们全都是平面图之类的内容。

sentences.en: But I, like, give him the visual analysis.
sentences.zh: 但我会向他做视觉分析。

sentences.en: These calls went on for two months.
sentences.zh: 这些通话持续了两个月。

sentences.en: And then in April, Isla learned of two major developments.
sentences.zh: 然后在 4 月份，艾丝拉获悉了两个重大进展。

sentences.en: First, ICE was going to enforce an order of removal against her dad, which meant he could be deported immediately.
sentences.zh: 首先，美国移民及海关执法局（ICE）准备对她父亲执行遣返令，这意味着他可能会被立即驱逐出境。

sentences.en: Second, ICE was moving him over 1,600 miles to a notorious detention center in Louisiana, which had been investigated by the Department of Homeland Security for alleged abuses.
sentences.zh: 其次，ICE 准备将他转移到 1600 英里外路易斯安那州的一个臭名昭著的拘留中心，该中心曾因涉嫌虐待而被国土安全部调查。

sentences.en: Isla says her dad's new detention center in Pine Prairie, Louisiana, is nothing like the one in Plymouth.
sentences.zh: 艾丝拉说，她父亲在路易斯安那州松树草原的新拘留中心与普利茅斯的那个完全不同。

sentences.en: It's quite literally a prison where people that actually committed real crimes would be in.
sentences.zh: 那简直就是关押真正犯下罪行之人的监狱。

sentences.en: Like, he's in a jail cell where it's just, like, ten times worse.
sentences.zh: 就像，他被关在一个糟糕程度呈十倍的牢房里。

sentences.en: Things feel different.
sentences.zh: 一切都变了感觉。

sentences.en: She senses that the brave face her dad had put on is starting to crack.
sentences.zh: 她感觉到她父亲强装出的坚强面具开始出现裂痕。

sentences.en: I don't want to say he's in full panic, but he's really feeling it.
sentences.zh: 我不想说他完全陷入了恐慌，但他确实感到了压力。

sentences.en: Even so, on the phone, like, I can hear himself let go.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，在电话里，我能听到他情绪的失控。

sentences.en: And this change in mood is starting to have an impact on Isla, too.
sentences.zh: 而这种情绪的变化也开始对艾丝拉产生影响。

sentences.en: There's something wrong.
sentences.zh: 出问题了。

sentences.en: My anxiety has been over the roof.
sentences.zh: 我的焦虑情绪一直高涨到极点。

sentences.en: If it just feels like it's so hard to get through your day, it's so hard.
sentences.zh: 如果你只是觉得度过一天都如此艰难，实在是太难了。

sentences.en: Like, you cannot tell me they'll be taking my dad and he will be in Brazil for the next 10 years up until we can reapply for him to come.
sentences.zh: 比如，你不能告诉我他们会带走我父亲，而他将在巴西待上整整 10 年，直到我们能重新申请让他回来。

sentences.en: Like, that does not cross my mind.
sentences.zh: 这根本不在我的脑海里出现过。

sentences.en: Oh, man.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Would you ever consider moving to Brazil to be with your dad if it came to that?
sentences.zh: 如果真到了那一步，你有没有考虑过搬到巴西去陪你爸爸？

sentences.en: As much as I would love to stay here and be like, yeah, my family is going to reunite in Brazil, it can't be a plan due to the fact that my parents have worked way too damn hard,
sentences.zh: 尽管我很想留在这里，然后说，是的，我的家人将在巴西团聚，但由于我的父母付出了该死的巨大努力，这个计划根本行不通，

sentences.en: too many years of their damn life to come here.
sentences.zh: 他们生命中该死的太多岁月都用来来到这里。

sentences.en: I will be continuing college.
sentences.zh: 我会继续上大学。

sentences.en: And if anything, I will be continuing their success times that by 100.
sentences.zh: 如果非要说的话，我会将他们的成就乘以 100 倍继续发扬光大。

sentences.en: I refuse to believe that they'll be throwing that away.
sentences.zh: 我拒绝相信他们会白白扔掉这一切。

sentences.en: And if I can even continue my dad's company to keep going and get other people to manage it, I will be continuing to making their name.
sentences.zh: 如果我甚至能继承我父亲的公司并让它继续运营，让其他人来管理它，我会继续延续他们的名声。

sentences.en: It's one thing to take my dad away from me.
sentences.zh: 把我的父亲从我身边夺走是一回事。

sentences.en: It's another to take everything that they worked hard for.
sentences.zh: 夺走他们辛苦工作得来的一切又是另一回事。

sentences.en: I wanted to ask, you know, what do you make of the fact that for a lot of Americans, your father's story, while sympathetic, might at the end of the day feel like,
sentences.zh: 我想问问，对于许多美国人来说，你父亲的故事虽然令人同情，但归根结底可能会让人觉得，

sentences.en: yeah, he ultimately was here, not legally.
sentences.zh: 是的，他终究是非法呆在这里的。

sentences.en: What would you say to those people who might agree with the administration's policies to remove people like your dad who don't have documentation here?
sentences.zh: 对于那些可能赞同政府驱逐像你父亲这样没有身份的人的政策的人，你会说些什么？

sentences.en: I'd get it if you're talking about a murderer that doesn't belong here and he's just out running on the street or I'd get that.
sentences.zh: 如果你们说的是一个不属于这里的杀人犯，而他正在街上到处乱跑，那我就能理解了。

sentences.en: But if you're okay with separating families because they're just simply immigrants, that's a battle you're dealing within yourself.
sentences.zh: 但如果你仅仅因为他们是移民就赞成拆散家庭，那是你内心需要挣扎的问题。

sentences.en: If they're hearing my story specifically, I hope they hear that and that they try to picture
sentences.zh: 如果他们专门听了我的故事，我希望他们听到后能试着想象

sentences.en: one of their daughters sitting here and having to talk about one of their parents like this because somebody out there is wishing that on somebody else.
sentences.zh: 他们的某位女儿坐在这里，不得不这样谈论自己的一位父母，因为总有人在把这种痛苦强加给别人。

sentences.en: And I just really want them to picture that.
sentences.zh: 我真的很希望他们能想象一下那个画面。

sentences.en: You mentioned you spent most of your life envisioning a future with your dad and going into business with your dad.
sentences.zh: 你提到你大半生都在设想与父亲共创未来以及和父亲一起经商。

sentences.en: Given everything that's happened, what is that dream now?
sentences.zh: 鉴于发生的一切，现在的那个梦想是什么？

sentences.en: Um, as of right now, there's like no dream, no goal.
sentences.zh: 嗯，就目前而言，好像没有什么梦想，也没有什么目标。

sentences.en: It's just like, okay, well, my dream is to kind of just be able to push through this.
sentences.zh: 就像是，好吧，我的梦想只是能够挺过这一关。

sentences.en: Have you dreamt about reuniting with your dad on the other hand?
sentences.zh: 另一方面，你有没有梦见过和父亲团聚？

sentences.en: That's been my little ideal dream since February 26th.
sentences.zh: 自从 2 月 26 日以来，那一直是我小小的理想梦想。

sentences.en: Just me getting that call of being told, go pick up your dad.
sentences.zh: 就是我接到那个电话，被告知去接我爸爸。

sentences.en: And all I could think of is me just like parking my car, getting out my car.
sentences.zh: 我脑子里想的只有我把车停好，从车里走出来。

sentences.en: He's standing outside, like quite literally the same exact person he left, like in his work clothes, just the way he is with his face, like his regular face.
sentences.zh: 他站在外面，简直就是他离开时的原样，穿着工装，就保持着他那张脸的样子，他平常的脸。

sentences.en: Mm, like no time had passed.
sentences.zh: 嗯，就像时间没有流逝过一样。

sentences.en: No, like literally no time has passed, but it feels like life spins upside down.
sentences.zh: 不，就像字面意思上时间没有流逝，但感觉生活天翻地覆。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And just hugging my dad and all I could literally do is cry, like cry my literal heart out.
sentences.zh: 然后拥抱我的爸爸，我能做的只有哭泣，简直是痛哭流涕。

sentences.en: Like everything that I've been holding in, like within these two months, that's exactly how I see.
sentences.zh: 就像我这俩月来一直压抑的所有情绪，正是我脑海里浮现的画面。

sentences.en: It just feels like it's going to happen and it's all I think about.
sentences.zh: 感觉这一定会发生，这也是我满脑子想的事情。

sentences.en: That's all I can envision, like over and over again, every single day that I wake up.
sentences.zh: 这就是我能想象到的全部画面，一遍又一遍，在我醒来的每一天里。

sentences.en: And it's just me, like it's not like my mom's around, my sister's around.
sentences.zh: 而且只有我和我，并不是我妈妈在身边，我姐姐在身边。

sentences.en: It's just like me and my dad.
sentences.zh: 就像只有我和我爸爸。

sentences.en: Isla never got the call to pick up her dad.
sentences.zh: 艾丝拉始终没有接到去接父亲的电话。

sentences.en: Instead, a few days after we had talked, she received news that her dad had been deported from the U.S.
sentences.zh: 相反，在我们交谈几天后，她收到了父亲已被从美国驱逐出境的消息。

sentences.en: to Brazil.
sentences.zh: 目的地是巴西。

sentences.en: So Isla packed a small suitcase for herself and a bigger one for her dad.
sentences.zh: 于是艾丝拉给自己打包了一个小行李箱，给父亲打包了一个大行李箱。

sentences.en: And she booked a ticket for one to Brazil.
sentences.zh: 她订了一张去巴西的单程机票。

sentences.en: And on Tuesday morning, at the arrivals terminal in Belo Horizonte Airport,
sentences.zh: 在周二早晨，贝洛奥里藏特机场的到达大厅里，

sentences.en: Isla finally got to be with her dad.
sentences.zh: 艾丝拉终于得以和父亲团聚。

sentences.en: After the break, senior producer Jessica Chung on what happened after Isla reunited with her father.
sentences.zh: 广告之后，资深制作人杰西卡·钟将讲述艾丝拉与父亲团聚后发生的事情。

sentences.en: Once you go through all the tunnel and everything, it's literally like a storefront door, like a sliding door.
sentences.zh: 当你走过所有的通道和一切之后，它简直就像是一个店面的门，像一扇推拉门。

sentences.en: It just slides and like they're behind that door.
sentences.zh: 它就这样拉开，然后他们就在那扇门后面。

sentences.en: And I literally see him like standing in front of the door.
sentences.zh: 我真的看到他就像站在门前一样。

sentences.en: I gave him a big hug.
sentences.zh: 我给了他一个大大的拥抱。

sentences.en: Like I missed him so much.
sentences.zh: 就像我太想念他了。

sentences.en: It was so shocking.
sentences.zh: 太令人震惊了。

sentences.en: It's just like, what am I doing in Brazil?
sentences.zh: 感觉就像，我在巴西干什么？

sentences.en: That was like such a weird moment where it's just like, I'm so happy to see him, but I'm in shock.
sentences.zh: 那真是一个非常诡异的时刻，就是那种我很高兴见到他，但我又处于震惊之中。

sentences.en: I'm like, what are we doing here?
sentences.zh: 我想，我们在这里干什么？

sentences.en: I guess this is it.
sentences.zh: 我想就是这样了。

sentences.en: Like, this is how things are for now.
sentences.zh: 就像，目前事情就是这个样子。

sentences.en: I guess that the feeling you're describing is that you don't feel like you belong there in Brazil.
sentences.zh: 我想你所描述的那种感觉是，你觉得你在巴西并不属于那里。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Relationship-wise and treating each other, completely normal.
sentences.zh: 从关系和彼此对待的方式来看，完全很正常。

sentences.en: For me, it was definitely that feeling of like, every day that I would wake up, it would be so weird.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，绝对是那种感觉，每天醒来都觉得太奇怪了。

sentences.en: It's like, hot there.
sentences.zh: 那里很热。

sentences.en: It's tropical.
sentences.zh: 那是热带气候。

sentences.en: I don't belong here.
sentences.zh: 我不属于这里。

sentences.en: I don't belong here.
sentences.zh: 我不属于这里。

sentences.en: This is not where my dad's supposed to be.
sentences.zh: 这不应该是爸爸待的地方。

sentences.en: This is not where I'm supposed to be waking up and like, time to see my dad adjust there too.
sentences.zh: 这不应该是我醒来并看着爸爸在那里适应的地方。

sentences.en: It's very weird to me.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说非常奇怪。

sentences.en: Like, it feels like he's like, on a like, vacation that there's no end date to.
sentences.zh: 就像，感觉他好像在度一个没有结束日期的假期。

sentences.en: Is there specific things you saw that like, triggered you into thinking, I'm not supposed to be here?
sentences.zh: 你有没有看到什么具体的事情，触发了你“我不应该呆在这里”的想法？

sentences.en: Is it like, the smell of, I don't know, the air?
sentences.zh: 是不是因为，我不知道，空气的味道？

sentences.en: No, it was seeing, it was actually like, seeing things.
sentences.zh: 不，是看到的，其实是看到了一些景象。

sentences.en: Seeing my dad with his brothers, I've never seen that a day in my life.
sentences.zh: 看到我爸爸和他的兄弟们在一起，我这辈子一天都没见过那样的场景。

sentences.en: Because he has four of them, actually.
sentences.zh: 因为他实际上有四个兄弟。

sentences.en: It was very weird to me.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说非常奇怪。

sentences.en: And I couldn't like, grasp it.
sentences.zh: 而且我无法理解。

sentences.en: They're just talking.
sentences.zh: 他们只是在聊天。

sentences.en: They have like, so much to catch up on within years.
sentences.zh: 他们有好多好多年积攒下来的事情要叙旧。

sentences.en: And it's not that he doesn't belong.
sentences.zh: 并不是说他不属于那里。

sentences.en: Obviously, that's his family.
sentences.zh: 很明显，那是他的家人。

sentences.en: But like, that is, you know, not his family, family.
sentences.zh: 但那是，你知道的，不是核心的家人。

sentences.en: Like, we're his family.
sentences.zh: 就像，我们才是他的家人。

sentences.en: Like, his future-wise, here.
sentences.zh: 就像，关于他的未来，在这里。

sentences.en: So seeing my dad, like, sitting there with the past, as if they're littles, and you know, the present is somewhere else.
sentences.zh: 所以看到我爸爸坐在那里面对着过去，仿佛他们还是小孩子，而你知道现实生活在其他地方。

sentences.en: It literally feels like he's catching up on the paSt.
sentences.zh: 这感觉就像他 literalmente 在追赶过去。

sentences.en: And in my opinion, not going anywhere.
sentences.zh: 依我看，他哪里也去不了。

sentences.en: You mentioned that you wanted, when we last talked, to work with your dad.
sentences.zh: 你提到过，当我们上次谈话时，你想和你的父亲一起工作。

sentences.en: And that the dream was to start a company, to design and build places.
sentences.zh: 梦想是创立一家公司，设计并建造房屋。

sentences.en: And I guess I wonder if that's still the plan.
sentences.zh: 我想知道这是否仍然是计划。

sentences.en: If you feel like that dream is still possible in some way.
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得这个梦想在某种程度上仍然有可能实现。

sentences.en: I definitely feel like the dream is possible.
sentences.zh: 我绝对觉得这个梦想是有可能实现的。

sentences.en: There is a change of plans, unfortunately.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，计划有所改变。

sentences.en: But that doesn't mean I can't continue his legacy.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着我不能延续他的传奇。

sentences.en: And my dad definitely didn't come here for, I believe, 20 or 24 years of his life here.
sentences.zh: 而且我坚信我爸爸来到这里，度过了他人生中 20 或 24 年的时光。

sentences.en: Built all this.
sentences.zh: 建造了这一切。

sentences.en: And let's give up.
sentences.zh: 让我们就此放弃吧。

sentences.en: It's a little crazy to say, but that actually made me a little bit more determined.
sentences.zh: 说出来可能有点疯狂，但这实际上让我更有决心了。

sentences.en: Like, it makes me work harder because he's not here.
sentences.zh: 这让我工作更加努力，因为他不在身边。

sentences.en: I do co-ops.
sentences.zh: 我参加了带薪实习项目。

sentences.en: I work full-time, you know, ever since life took a big turn financial-wise.
sentences.zh: 自从生活在财务上发生重大转折以来，我一直在全职工作。

sentences.en: So I'm always constantly working when I'm not in school.
sentences.zh: 所以我没上学的时候，几乎一直在工作。

sentences.en: It's a very busy life.
sentences.zh: 生活非常忙碌。

sentences.en: I just work.
sentences.zh: 我就是工作。

sentences.en: I just work and go to school and the cycle repeats every single day.
sentences.zh: 我就是工作、上学，日复一日，周而复始。

sentences.en: I kind of took this as a sign of, like, I need to get up and kind of do my own thing, build my life.
sentences.zh: 我把这当作是一个信号，觉得我得振作起来，过我自己的生活，建立我的人生。

sentences.en: I can't depend on my parents.
sentences.zh: 我不能依赖父母。

sentences.en: Like, they're always there for moral support, phone call away.
sentences.zh: 虽然他们一直都在精神上支持我，打个电话就能联系到。

sentences.en: But I need to grow up.
sentences.zh: 但我需要长大了。

sentences.en: I put my foot on the ground and say, well, I'm going to make the best of it.
sentences.zh: 我坚定立场，对自己说，好吧，我要好好利用这一切。

sentences.en: Today's episode was reported and produced by Jessica Chung.
sentences.zh: 本期节目由杰西卡·钟（Jessica Chung）报道并制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Michael Benoit and Jody Becker, with help from Ben Calhoun.
sentences.zh: 由迈克尔·贝努瓦（Michael Benoit）和乔迪·贝克尔（Jody Becker）剪辑，本·卡尔霍恩（Ben Calhoun）提供了协助。

sentences.en: It was fact-checked by Susan Lee.
sentences.zh: 由苏珊·李（Susan Lee）进行事实核查。

sentences.en: Contains music by Dan Powell, Pat McCusker, Alicia Baetup, Will Reed, and Marion Lozano.
sentences.zh: 包含丹·鲍威尔（Dan Powell）、帕特·麦卡斯克（Pat McCusker）、艾莉西亚·贝图普（Alicia Baetup）、威尔·里德（Will Reed）和马里昂·洛扎诺（Marion Lozano）的音乐。

sentences.en: And was engineered by Alyssa Moxley, Rowan Amisto, and Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 由艾丽莎·莫克斯利（Alyssa Moxley）、罗文·阿米斯托（Rowan Amisto）和克里斯·伍德（Chris Wood）担任录音工程。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗（Michael Barbaro）。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我们明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 在本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们正在为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人们宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是那种对光线极度敏感、需要完全黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝断片了才睡着的。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症吗？对食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用上或在你喜欢的任何平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。
